title: On some Diophantine and Ergodic properties of the Schneider map over function fields
summary: We introduce and study continued fractions defined by Schneider-like maps over polynomial rings, where the maps are associated with a fixed polynomial of arbitrary degree. In particular, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the continued fraction expansion for every element of the field of Laurent series. We then establish precise Diophantine approximation properties of the corresponding convergents.
